findings.statement: CA9 is up in tumour at RNA (log2FC 6.312) and protein (log2FC 2.269), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 9.712) and survives purity extrapolation (RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 7.787). It has clinical-stage agents (girentuximab PHASE_3). It is not prognostic in TCGA (Cox log HR -0.009).

SCARB1 tops the target profile (rank 1, score 4.1314): RNA log2FC 2.974, protein log2FC 1.837, TCGA log2FC 3.989, and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.762, so the signal is tumour-intrinsic. CNV loss frequency is 0, and it is not prognostic (Cox log HR -0.038).

CD70 is up in tumour at RNA (log2FC 4.464) and protein (log2FC 2.421), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 7.09), and holds at purity 1 (RNA log2FC 4.278). It has clinical-stage antibody agents (cusatuzumab PHASE_2). It is not prognostic (Cox log HR 0.126, padj 0.175).

ENPP3 is a membrane enzyme up in tumour at RNA (log2FC 3.895) and protein (log2FC 1.544), with TCGA log2FC 5.557 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 5.278. CNV loss frequency is 0.182, and an ADC (AGS-16C3F) reached PHASE_2.

NNMT is up at RNA (log2FC 4.67) and protein (log2FC 2.709), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 4.685), and is prognostic (Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479, higher expression means worse survival). RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 5.256.

SLC16A3 (MCT4, a lactate exporter) is up at RNA (log2FC 3.435) and protein (log2FC 2.279), with TCGA log2FC 3.291 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.821. Its CNV loss frequency is 0.018 and its cis CNV-RNA rho is 0.258.

FABP6 is up at RNA (log2FC 4.006) and protein (log2FC 1.921), with TCGA log2FC 6.431. CNV gain frequency is 0.573 and cis rho is 0.309, so part of the increase is a dosage effect. It is a tumour biomarker rather than a validated target.

HK2 is up at RNA (log2FC 3.351) and protein (log2FC 2.106), with TCGA log2FC 3.974 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.989. It is a metabolic reprogramming candidate, but its DepMap mean effect is -0.123 and it is not prognostic (Cox padj 0.253).

PSAT1 is down in tumour at RNA (log2FC -3.867) and protein (log2FC -1.963) and tops the biomarker profile (rank 1, score 5.3696). TCGA log2FC is -2.974, and higher expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR 0.43, padj 5.66e-7).

ALDH6A1 is down at RNA (log2FC -3.399) and protein (log2FC -1.925) and sits on 14q with CNV loss frequency 0.355. Its cis rho is 0.525, a real dosage effect. Higher expression predicts better survival (Cox log HR -0.554, padj 9.45e-12), so it is a prognostic tubule-identity biomarker.

SLC6A19, a proximal tubule transporter, is down at RNA (log2FC -4.574) and protein (log2FC -1.48). TCGA log2FC is -3.221, and higher expression predicts better survival (Cox log HR -0.456, padj 1.07e-7). It marks loss of normal tubule identity.
PBRM1 is mutated in 185 of 511 tumours (freq 0.362, padj 4.59e-239) and has 3p CNV loss frequency 0.8 in CPTAC.
VHL is mutated in 247 of 511 tumours (freq 0.483, obs/exp 462.707) and has 3p CNV loss frequency 0.791 in CPTAC, consistent with a biallelic hit that drives the HIF-dependent up-regulation of CA9.

caveats: Statistics are quoted from the integration rows and tools; no independent testing was done.
Up-regulated membrane candidates (CA9, CD70, ENPP3, SCARB1) have DepMap effects near 0 or positive, so tumour dependency is not demonstrated.
Down-regulated genes (PSAT1, ALDH6A1, SLC6A19) reflect loss of tubule identity and suit biomarker rather than target use.
Only the top of the convergence, target and biomarker rankings was reviewed, and phospho and kinase layers were not queried.
